title.zh: 共享存量上的汲取：每种组合都在存量之内，当且仅当总和在内
title.en: Draws on one shared stock: every combination fits exactly when the total does

claim.zh: 前 n 项以自然数给出的汲取中，每一种选取都在存量之内，当且仅当它们的总和在存量之内。
claim.en: Of the first n draws, given as natural numbers, every selection fits within the stock exactly when their total does.

hypotheses.zh: 汲取是可相加的自然数；存量是它们共同汲取的同一个量。
hypotheses.en: The draws are natural numbers that add; the stock is the one quantity they all draw on.

correspondence.zh: 在源模型中，每项汲取是一项活动无过渡损失地停止所需的工作，存量是为此留出的部分。这些数不是一般的价值度量；与实际活动和存量的对应需另行核实。
correspondence.en: In the source model, each draw is the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss, and the stock is what is set aside for that work. The numbers are not a general measure of value; their correspondence to actual activities and stocks needs separate evidence.

detail.zh: 支持身份与可加总量不同，没有已证通用转换。
detail.en: Support identity differs from additive quantity; no verified general adapter.

detail.zh: 静态总量条件不提供动态方案的观察与作用覆盖。
detail.en: A static total does not supply a dynamic plan’s observation and effect coverage.

detail.zh: 每项单独在内不推出共同在内：两项各为二单位的汲取可以竞争同一个二单位的存量。
detail.en: Each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two units each can compete for one stock of two.

limitations.zh: 每项单独在内不推出共同在内：两项各为二单位的汲取可以竞争同一个二单位的存量。
limitations.en: Each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two units each can compete for one stock of two.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 汲取在同一共享存量上相加之处可直接复用；其他支持类型需明确转换或另证。
next_delta.en: Reuse wherever draws add on one shared stock; other kinds of support need a stated translation or a separate proof.

history.en: 2026-10-10: internal names restated in structural words at Ren's request. The record ID aggregate-exit-funding became draws-on-a-shared-stock, with the old ID kept as an alias so historical checks still resolve; the Lean theorems all_coalitions_funded_iff_joint_total and individually_affordable_exits_can_fail_jointly became every_selection_within_iff_total_within and each_within_alone_not_together, with parameters claims and reserve renamed draws and stock. Both Lean checks were rerun and passed; the proofs are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3c（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（Becoming.Weighted 的列出论域上的质量律）。前 n 项汲取依后先列出是一个论域（SharedStockInstances.firstDraws），一种选取是其上的事件，汲取是其权重：选取的总和即该事件的质量，总和即全域的质量（selectedTotal_eq_mass、total_eq_mass）。于是每种选取都在存量之内恰当总和在内，即核心的 every_event_within_iff（every_selection_within_iff_total_within）；两项各为二的汲取分别在二之内而合起来不在，全域的质量为四（each_within_alone_not_together，同核心的 entries_within_not_together）。CorrectionDependence 的原证明与回执保持原范围。外围实例模块由其检查器实查（Lean 4.30.0-rc2，回执 20261015T151857.892080Z），五条声明的公理报告都为空；所实例化的核心律由核心运行审计（回执 20261015T150956.178111Z）。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3c (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (Becoming.Weighted’s law of masses on a listed domain). The first n draws listed latest first are a domain (SharedStockInstances.firstDraws), a selection is an event on it and the draws are its weighting: the selected total is the selection’s mass and the total the whole domain’s (selectedTotal_eq_mass, total_eq_mass). So every selection fits within the stock exactly when the total does, which is the core’s every_event_within_iff (every_selection_within_iff_total_within), and two draws of two each fit a stock of two but not together, the whole domain’s mass being four (each_within_alone_not_together, as the core’s entries_within_not_together). CorrectionDependence’s proof and receipt keep their scope. The periphery instance module is checked by its own checker (Lean 4.30.0-rc2, receipt 20261015T151857.892080Z), all five declarations with empty axiom reports; the core law it instantiates is audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T150956.178111Z).

history.zh: 2026-10-16，P114 散立的模块在共同基底上陈述（研究 §138；Ren 2026-10-15：“so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”）：主律在共同基底上陈述，不加前提：在网的一步，对一个列出的形成家族，每种选取在一个条件上的需要都在该条件水平之内，恰当整个家族的需要在内（selections_within_iff）；网 twoDrawers 中每个形成在步 0 都被支持，两者的需要合起来却超出条件的水平（supported_not_together）。Becoming.Courses 由核心运行编译与审计（回执 20261015T172257.067968Z），公理报告为空。论断、假设、Ren 的话、依赖与既有证明不变；只加引用、绑定、别名与本条。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: at a step of a web, for a listed family of formations, the needs on one condition of every selection are within the condition's level exactly when the needs of the whole family are (selections_within_iff); in the web twoDrawers each formation is supported at step 0 while their needs together exceed the level (supported_not_together). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
